up: Find the first 1000 activity rows where the standard type is IC50, the standard relation is exactly '=' (i.e., pChEMBL values), and the target is the human protein target with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL2007629 (26S proteasome non-ATPase regulatory subunit 14). Return assay ChEMBL ID, the target type (e.g., SINGLE PROTEIN, PROTEIN, etc.), the target's tax_id, the canonical SMILES of the compound (from compound_structures), the molecule's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), the standard type, and the pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Filter activities to those where pChEMBL value is not null, and where the target is a SINGLE PROTEIN targeting the specified CHEMBL ID. Return exactly these columns and order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. No additional filtering, grouping, or limits beyond the 1000 rows is requested; the 1000‑row cap applies to the total result set, not to any intermediate join step.
sql:
WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id,
         a.molecule_chembl_id,
         a.assay_id,
         a.pchembl_value,
         a.standard_type,
         s.canonical_smiles
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN molecule_structures s ON a.molecule_chembl_id = s.molecule_chembl_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2007629'
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND a.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
)
SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       filtered_activities.canonical_smiles,
       filtered_activities.molecule_chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       filtered_activities.standard_type,
       filtered_activities.pchembl_value AS p_chembl_value
FROM filtered_activities
JOIN assays ass ON filtered_activities.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
ORDER BY filtered_activities.molecule_chembl_id,
         ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
